questions.evidence: Jerusalem remembers in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that were from the days of old

questions.q: What does Lamentations say is new every morning?
questions.evidence: It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassion doesn’t fail. They are new every morning

questions.q: What does Jerusalem ask all who pass by?
questions.evidence: Is it nothing to you, all you who pass by

questions.q: What does the last chapter of Lamentations ask Yahweh to do?
options: Remember what has come on them
questions.evidence: Remember, Yahweh, what has come on us: Look, and see our reproach
